metadata.title: High-Contrast Halftone Portrait with Inline Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, two-tone portrait style featuring vertical line-screen halftone textures and multi-line inline display typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic portrait defined by a coarse vertical line-screen halftone effect, where the subject's features are rendered in a single dark tone against a light background, paired with bold, rounded inline typography in a contrasting warm hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject features defined by vertical line density
Typography anchored to the upper left quadrant
High contrast between dark brown/maroon and off-white
Warm orange-red accent color for text elements
coreInvariants: Vertical line-screen halftone texture across the subject
Limited three-color palette (Dark Brown, Off-White, Orange-Red)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold display text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright orange text in the top left, moves down through the tracklist, then across to the textured face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant off-white space in the top right and bottom left to balance the heavy texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark chocolate brown for the halftone portrait and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between background and subject; high saturation for the accent text.

letterConstructionRules: Internal inline stroke following the outer contour
characterSpecificRedesigns: Double-line inline effect for the main title
Solid fill for secondary metadata text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and inline treatments to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Color block overlay in the bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded geometric skeleton and inline style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man with 1960s hair, rendered using a coarse vertical line-screen halftone effect in dark brown on an off-white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase rounded geometric text in the top left corner using a vibrant orange-red color, featuring an inline stroke effect.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture composed of vertical lines?
Is the text orange-red with an inline effect?
Is the palette limited to three main colors?
Is the portrait high-contrast with minimal mid-tones?

mustAchieve: Visible vertical line texture in the shadows
High-contrast duotone appearance for the image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical lines are distinct and not blurred.
Ensure the inline text is legible and correctly colored.
Verify the composition maintains the left-heavy typographic balance.
Confirm the absence of photographic mid-tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Line Halftone Portrait + Rounded Inline Typography + Tri-color Retro Palette
